description: Container for historical benchmark result bundles. IMPORTANT: not all contents are superseded -- e3_long_scaling_2026-09-10 remains active manuscript evidence (see its entry below); e1_raccess_exact_2026-09-10 was superseded on 2026-09-16 (see its entry); e2_approximation_envelope_2026-09-10 and the bpRNA/memory bundles are genuinely unused.
reason: Consolidated 2026-09-15 to reduce ambiguity between historical small-sample experiments (E1/E2/E3, 2026-09-10) and the current large-scale evidence (bpRNA 26,063-sequence run benchmark/results/bprna_runs/8666393, and the 12,872-sequence accuracy comparison benchmark/results/bprna_accuracy_comparison/). See docs/remaining_tasks_20260914.md and docs/todo_p0_p1_20260915.md.

contents.e1_raccess_exact_2026-09-10: SUPERSEDED (2026-09-16): was the source of the manuscript's §3.1 exact-mode validation numbers (4 named RNA sequences -- tRNA-Phe, SAM-I riboswitch, SRP RNA, RNase P RNA -- 2,408 cells, median 1.9e-9, max 1.4e-6, Spearman 0.999999998) until 2026-09-16, when the author requested replacing the named-RNA-family validation set with randomly generated sequences (to avoid needing to explain specific RNA families in the manuscript, since this validation only tests exact-mode numerical agreement, not biological relevance). Replaced by benchmark/results/e1_random_2026-09-16 (300 random 100nt sequences, 114,900 cells, median 3.6e-8, max 1.6e-6, Spearman 0.99999999999). Genuinely historical now; kept for provenance of the earlier claim only.
contents.e2_approximation_envelope_2026-09-10: Original beam/cap/log-sum-exp approximation-envelope sweep on synthetic RNA. Internal same-model test (engine=lincapr, Turner2004, beam=200), not an independent Raccess-oracle validation. Genuinely superseded/unused: the manuscript no longer cites its numbers (see docs/manuscript_review_20260915c.md item 1).
contents.e3_long_scaling_2026-09-10: CORRECTION (2026-09-15, later): this bundle is NOT superseded -- it is the actual source of the manuscript's §3.3 SARS-CoV-2 169-second whole-genome timing figure (raw repetitions 169.21/168.62/168.77s at 29,903nt). No replacement whole-genome timing experiment exists under any later pinned revision (892c93c8 or bbba4549, see software.lock.json); this archived run (revision 51ed3c3, engine=lincapr, Turner2004, beam=100) is still active manuscript evidence for the runtime/memory scaling claims, which the manuscript documents as engine-independent implementation properties rather than accuracy claims.
contents.bprna_validation: Historical bpRNA validation attempt using an earlier (non-chunked) job runner. Superseded by benchmark/results/bprna_runs/8666393.
contents.current_validation_20260914: Orphaned 2026-09-14 validation attempt (e1/e2 regression checks). Its e1_regression/ subdirectory happens to contain data identical to e1_raccess_exact_2026-09-10/ (a regression-check duplicate, not an independent source); e2_regression/ is an unused duplicate of the genuinely-superseded e2_approximation_envelope_2026-09-10/.
contents.bprna_memory_runs_8676148: Earlier bpRNA memory-scaling run superseded by benchmark/results/bprna_memory_runs/8677021, which is what benchmark/scripts/plot_figure3_memory_comparison.py (the script that produced the current Figure 3) actually uses.
